explanations: bid() caches compiled rules keyed by campaign id and version, but it creates the cache Map inside bid(), so the cache is thrown away after every request. Every request that reaches a campaign's targeting check re-parses its rule text. That's the expensive regex work the profile shows, and it grows with traffic. The fix moves the Map to a Bidder field, so each campaign's rule is compiled once and reused until the version changes. The version check still recompiles an edited campaign on its next request.
